subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a narrower reminder/plugin-owned classifier first?
rationale: This changes durable cron schema, Gateway protocol, CLI/API/UI behavior, and likely reminder/plugin scheduling semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent classification model alone.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow first-party cron classification/display contract that can serve reminders, system jobs, plugin-created jobs, and UI filtering without opaque drift.

options.title: Freeform tags
options.body: Implement optional string tags directly, accepting a flexible taxonomy but leaving typed reminder/display semantics for later.

options.title: Defer behind Reminders design
options.body: Keep this broad request open until the narrower Reminders tab work chooses the classifier needed for that user flow.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow first-party cron classification/display contract that can serve reminders, system jobs, plugin-created jobs, and UI filtering without opaque drift.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the most relevant existing maintainer signal by closing the related metadata PR for an owner-reviewed design slice.
